records.publication_status: ICLR 2026 according to the saved RelBench v2 citation; independent acceptance source not audited
records.saved_takeaway: RelGT is a recent temporal heterogeneous transformer with a complete released trainer, five-element tokenization, local attention and EMA global centroids. On small F1 driver-position, pinned fresh precomputation loses forecast-time identity, so source availability does not establish execution readiness.
paper_evidence: F1 rows 7,453/499/760, 826 unique entities and 44.6 percent train/test overlap.
Local sampling is described as history-valid; token encoders model features, type, hop, relative time and stochastic GNN positional encodings. Global centroids update by EMA.
Small tasks tune L in {1,4,8} and dropout in {.3,.4,.5}; K=300, centroids=4096, width512 in author launcher, batch256, lr1e-4.
Headline F1 MAE: test3.9170±.3448, val3.3257±.5618; HeteroGNN test4.022±.119, val3.193±.024.
Nine-config table has lowest test at L1/dropout.5, but lowest validation at L4/dropout.3 (val3.1046,test4.6316). Cross-configuration selection is not closed by the scoped description.
author_source_evidence: Full L1/MAE trainer, Adam, clip norm1, validation-selected checkpoint and final test evaluation exist.
utils.py stores and retrieves neighborhoods by entity ID, with 10,000-row chunks; repeated forecast rows therefore collide.
No-neighbor fallback samples all graph nodes without a seed-time filter.
Sampling seed uses Python hash of a string-containing tuple; cache path lacks a complete seed/source provenance identity.
Source stochastic PE is drawn in every forward, including evaluation; EMA centroids update in training only.
The snapshot is July2025, predating the latest February2026 primary; dependencies are unpinned.
records.candidate_relationship: A smaller useful setting for supervised initialization of shared-backbone/private-factor committees, conditional on an independently qualified forecaster and corrected/attributed forecast-context source.
records.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute typed/time/hop encoders, stochastic positional encoding and local/global attention. The proposed gap is initialization utility beyond common/random/topology controls and head-only/independent ensemble gains at measured cost.
limitations: No data, labels, model weights, notebooks or numerical outputs accessed; published metrics are literature evidence only.
Potential leakage conditions and repeated-row collisions are source findings, not a measured leakage rate or a causal explanation for published results.
No run-count/standard-deviation semantics established from the scoped primary, despite reported ± values.
No source repair, dependency lock, GPU qualification or reproduction was attempted.
Negative current execution-readiness recommendation; does not claim paper results are invalid or RelGT is latest global best.

exact_read_scope.read_reason: Smaller F1 task and non-graph competence, distinct from H&M scout

records.saved_takeaway: F1 is a small nine-table temporal heterogeneous regression setting. Raw LightGBM is a meaningful native control here (testMAE4.170 vs globalmedian4.399), while author engineered SQL needs a declared future-schedule information policy.
paper_evidence: F1 driver-position forecast counts7,453/499/760; native task SQL averages positionOrder over the next60days.
Original raw LightGBM validation/testMAE3.450/4.170; HeteroGNN3.193/4.022; globalmedian4.136/4.399.
source_evidence: Pinned legacy task has timedelta60days and num_eval_timestamps40; row key driverId/date.

The label SQL is conditioned on future race participation and its active-driver subquery has no upper time bound. Preserve benchmark cohort definition rather than invent an all-driver prospective forecast population.
User-study F1 SQL has50engineeredfeatures plus keys/target in the stype mapping; future upcoming race schedule is an explicit input.
Raw native LightGBM tuner has10trials,MAE,full-data coverage on this task and optional AR labels disabled by default.
limitations: Exact engineered user-study F1 score was not numerically inspected.
Data maximum and retained forecast rows are not locally verified.
Saved latest RelBench v2 R²-primary context is reused; new study must disclose legacy MAE profile.

execution_recommendation: NEGATIVE_FOR_PINNED_NATIVE_SOURCE; retain task for separately resolved source qualification
